name: 21-convert-claude-prompt-postfix-syshuman
description: convertClaudePrompt with the two paths 20 leaves alone: `addAssistantPostfix` appends an assistant turn carrying `addAssistantPrefill || ''` (:137-143), and `withSysPromptSupport && useSystemPrompt` keeps the first turn as 'system' and, because the first assistant turn sits at index 2 with no user turn before it, splices `addSysHumanMsg` in as a user turn at that index (:154-161). The splice lands *before* the assistant turn, so it does not become the assistant the `hasUser` scan matches. The prefill string keeps its trailing space -- the postfix is the one Claude path that does not trim (:141).
